dog.description_text:
Come meet me and 100+ of my adoptable friends at Louie's Legacy Animal Rescue's MEGA adoption event, Home for the Holidays! Saturday, November 21st, 2026 at Woodbridge High School in Woodbridge, NJ from 11am - 3pm!

Meet Maisie!

Maisie is a 6-month-old Chihuahua/Dachshund mix weighing just 12 pounds, and if you’re looking for a loving, playful puppy who wants to be your very best friend, she’s your girl! With her adorable cow-like markings and sweet personality, this little girl is sure to steal your heart.

Maisie loves being close to her person and is happiest sitting right beside you, soaking up attention and getting all the belly rubs and puppy kisses she can possibly manage. She also loves squeaky toys and running around the yard with her favorite toys.

Maisie has been a wonderful, easy puppy to foster! Her foster mom works from home, which has helped her thrive with house-training. She is fully housetrained, goes outside to do her business, and has had no accidents in the house. She can hold it overnight for up to seven hours and will whine or go to the door to let you know when she needs to go out. No pee pads needed! She also sleeps on the couch overnight without any issues.

She’s a great eater, well-behaved in the house (with the occasional puppy antics), and has been no bother at all to her much smaller Pomeranian foster siblings. Maisie is also incredibly smart and learned "sit" and "come" after just two days of practice, especially with a little bacon as extra motivation!

There are a few things her future family should know. Maisie is not a fan of crates and gets upset when confined, although she can settle in a small, puppy-proofed room. Leash training is also a work in progress, as she currently refuses to walk on a leash. She may carry it around like a toy, but she'll need a patient family to help her build confidence and learn to enjoy walks.

Like any puppy, Maisie needs plenty of appropriate chew toys, treats, and playtime to keep her happy and engaged. She loves carrying around Crocs and may chew on woodwork if left unsupervised, so she'll benefit from continued supervision and guidance as she grows.

Above all, Maisie is an incredibly loving, affectionate puppy who will bring so much joy to the lucky person who welcomes her home. She'll thrive with a family willing to continue her training and give her all the love, attention, and patience she deserves.

Maisie is currently being fostered in Spring Lake Heights, NJ. Her adoption fee is $575.

To adopt this animal, please visit https://www.louieslegacy.org/adopt

All of our animals come spayed or neutered, up to date on age appropriate vaccinations, are microchipped, heartworm negative, current on flea/tick and heartworm prevention, dewormed, and treated for any ailments found upon veterinary examination. The adoption fee covers a portion of these services, and makes it possible for us to continue rescuing animals.

For more information on the adoption fees and the adoption process, please complete our adoption application here: https://www.louieslegacy.org/adopt - an application allows us to get to know your family better so we can assess whether the animal you are interested in is a good match for your home. An application does not obligate you to adopt. Please understand that due to the volume of applications some animals receive, we are unable to contact all applicants. If your application is considered a good fit for the animal you are interested in, or even a different pet, a volunteer will give you a call as soon as possible.

We are a foster based rescue and do not have a shelter location where animals can be seen during the week. Please see our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/LouiesLegacy for our weekly adoption album if you are interested in meeting an animal in person. Not all animals attend every adoption event, please check our Facebook page for animal event times and locations before you make a trip to meet a specific animal.
